newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Ansett launches free tickets promotion.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Ansett launches free tickets promotion.

text.p: Ansett Australia on Tuesday launched a promotion offering 8,000 free domestic tickets and 2,000 free international tickets on its flights to customers using the airline between August 18 to September 12.

The airline, jointly owned by Air New Zealand and News Corp, said its Great Inflight Giveaway promotion would see a winner on each of the 10,000 flights within Australia which Ansett would operate during the promotion.
Ansett said a promotions consultant retained by Ansett had temporarily recruited 200 inflight coordinators to administer the competition on borad aircrafts and in airports.
The airline said a national print and television campaign would be launched on August 7.
Ansett competes against Qantas Airways Ltd in the domestic market.
